examples.title: Example 1: Adding a Scroll Event
examples.description:
In this example, a vertical list is implemented, and a callback is invoked when the first or last item displayed in the list changes.
ListDataSource implements the LazyForEach data source API IDataSource, which is used to provide child components for List through LazyForEach.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting Child Element Alignment
examples.description:
This example showcases the alignment effects of child elements in the cross-axis direction of the List component using different ListItemAlign enumeration values.
For details about ListDataSource and the complete code, see Example 1: Adding a Scroll Event.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Edit Mode
examples.description:
This example illustrates how to set whether the current List component is in edit mode.
For details about ListDataSource and the complete code, see Example 1: Adding a Scroll Event.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Alignment Mode for the Scroll Snap Position
examples.description:
This example shows how to configure the List component to align the scroll snap position to the center.
For details about ListDataSource and the complete code, see Example 1: Adding a Scroll Event.

examples.title: Example 5: Implementing Accurate Scrolling
examples.description:
This example shows that, by setting the childrenMainSize attribute, the list can jump to an exact specific location when the scrollTo API is called, even when the heights of the child components are inconsistent.
For usage with state management V2, see List and makeObserved.
For details about ListDataSource and the complete code, see Example 1: Adding a Scroll Event.

examples.title: Example 6: Obtaining Child Component Index Information
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to obtain index information of list items in a List component when groups are involved.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting Edge Fading
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to implement a List component with an edge fading effect and set the length of the fading edge.
For details about ListDataSource and the complete code, see Example 1: Adding a Scroll Event.

examples.title: Example 8: Setting the Single-Side Edge Effect
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set a single-side edge effect for the List component using the edgeEffect API.
For details about ListDataSource and the complete code, see Example 1: Adding a Scroll Event.

examples.title: Example 9: Setting Focus Wrap on a List
examples.description: In API version 20 and later versions, this example uses the focusWrapMode API to implement the effect of line-wrapping focus navigation with arrow keys in the List component.

examples.title: Example 10: Keeping the Display Content Unchanged When Data Is Inserted Outside the Display Area
examples.description:
This example uses the maintainVisibleContentPosition API to implement infinite loading of historical messages when the screen is swiped up.
For details about ListDataSource and the complete code, see Example 1: Adding a Scroll Event.

examples.title: Example 11: Setting the Margin of the Scrollbar
examples.description: Starting from API version 20, this example shows how to use the scrollBarMargin attribute to set the scrollbar margin and avoid the contentStartOffset and contentEndOffset areas.

examples.title: Example 12: Implementing Dragging with OnMove
examples.description: Starting from API version 12, this example demonstrates how to use the onMove API of ForEach to sort items by dragging them. The list can automatically scroll when an item is dragged to the edge of the list.

examples.title: Example 13: Configuring Lanes Based on Breakpoints
examples.description:
In API version 22 and later versions, this example shows how to configure lanes in the List component based on breakpoints.
For details about ListDataSource and the complete code, see Example 1: Adding a Scroll Event.

examples.title: Example 14: Obtaining the Total Content Size
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to obtain the total content size of the List component. This functionality is supported since API version 22.

examples.title: Example 15: Dragging Between Two Lists
examples.description: This example demonstrates the drag and drop effect of list times between two List components using events such as OnItemDragStart.

examples.title: Example 16: Centering the Clicked Item in ListItemGroup
examples.description: This example uses the scrollToItemInGroup API to implement the effect of centering the ListItem component in the ListItemGroup when the ListItem is clicked.

examples.title: Example 17: Setting the Multi-Selection Gather Animation
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to gather selected list items in the visible area when a long press is performed on list items using bindContextMenu, with the multi-selection gather animation switch enabled for List.
Since API version 23, the editModeOptions API is added to the List component to set the multi-selection gather animation switch.
For details about ListDataSource and the complete code, see Example 1: Adding a Scroll Event.
